item.title: 🌹 The Way of the Heart & The Way of the Rubbles: NFTs That Speak for Palestine
item.description: In a world where digital art meets activism, two NFTs emerge not just as visual statements—but as emotional testaments to resilience, love, and memory. 💗 The Way of the Heart A heart, tender yet enduring, cradles a blooming rose. This NFT symbolizes the quiet strength of compassion, the beauty that persists even in pain. The rose grows from the heart—not despite it, but because of it. It’s a tribute to those who choose love in the face of loss, and to the emotional roots that nourish resistance.

item.title: 🌿 Transcending Death Through Art: Rumi’s “Any Soul That Drank the Nectar” Reimagined as NFT.
item.description: In a world saturated with fleeting visuals, true art whispers to the soul. Our latest NFT release, inspired by Mewlana Jalaluddin Rumi’s mystical poem “Any Soul That Drank the Nectar,” invites collectors into a realm where passion defies mortality and fragrance outlives flesh. ✨ The Poem That Breathed Life Into Pixels “Death came, smelled me, and sensed your fragrance instead. From then on, death lost all hope of me.” — Rumi

item.title: 🌙 At The Twilight: A Soulful NFT Inspired by Rumi’s Mystical Verse.
item.description: ✨ Introduction: Where Poetry Meets the Blockchain In a world increasingly digitized, the soul still seeks meaning. That’s why I created an NFT artwork inspired by one of the most hauntingly beautiful poems by Mewlana Jalaluddin Rumi: At The Twilight. This piece is more than just a token—it’s a portal into the metaphysical, a visual meditation on the soul’s journey beyond the self. Whether you’re a collector of spiritual NFTs, a lover of Rumi’s timeless wisdom, or simply exploring art that speaks to the heart, this creation invites you to pause, reflect, and connect.

item.title: 🪞 "Mirror" as NFT: Truth, Reflection, and the Eye of a Digital Spirit.
item.description: In a world obsessed with filters and curated realities, the mirror remains one of the few objects that refuses to lie. Inspired by Sylvia Plath’s piercing poem Mirror, our latest NFT artwork captures the raw essence of truth—unbiased, unfiltered, and unflinching. 🔍 What Is the “Mirror” NFT? This NFT is a visual meditation on Plath’s lines: “I am silver and exact. I have no preconceptions. Whatever I see I swallow immediately Just as it is, unmisted by love or dislike.

item.title: 🔮 Breathing Digital Life into Rumi: My NFT Tribute to “Any Lifetime”.
item.description: In a world increasingly shaped by pixels and blockchain, I wanted to create something that transcends the digital — something that speaks to the soul. That’s how my latest NFT artwork was born: a visual meditation on Mewlana Jalaluddin Rumi’s poem “Any Lifetime.” 🧠 The Poem That Sparked a Vision “Any lifetime that is spent without seeing the master Is either death in disguise or a deep sleep. The water that pollutes you is poison; The poison that purifies you is water.
